== Description ==
Original (2005) Players Committee slip of [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon) (Original)|Watch Your Step (V)]] (0 side of the objective), as printed on the first [[Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon]] sheet (VirtualCards9.pdf, PDF created 13 May 2005), before the December 2006 Remaster. The printed label above the slip is included.

== Source and credit ==
* Source document: [[Media:Original_Virtual_Set_9_card_slips.pdf|Original Virtual Set 9 card slips.pdf]] ([[:File:Original Virtual Set 9 card slips.pdf|file page]]), PDF page 2, slip 24 (printed collector mark 9•24). The PDF (SHA-1 b86945376c015619a16c19ee94f16ae502984c57) is the wiki copy of Players Committee forum attachment 16602 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16602 VirtualCards9.pdf]), posted by Throdo in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1047092#p1047092 Original 17 VSet PDFs & Pre-Reset Block PDFs], 13 July 2016. Preserved copy of the post: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261124024945/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1047092.html Internet Archive].
* Derivation: PDF page 2 rendered at 300 dpi (poppler pdftoppm), the slip with its printed label cut out (pixel box 863,1358–1621,1874 of the 2550 × 3300 render) and saved as PNG. Nothing else was changed.
* Publisher: the Players Committee, 2005. Original card imagery © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. Fair use: the image identifies the published card on this non-commercial fan wiki.
